title: Unit Event — Putting Feelings Into Words — Episode7 Unwavering Feelings

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need has begun performing in earnest at the live house. Honami comes up with a schedule to ensure that they can all work on their performance without overexerting themselves, but then she notices that Shiho seems different from usual...

rows.Line: Live House

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(I've sold quite a few now...
But I'll still have some left over at this rate.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (The others are probably busy working on our new song, so I'll just have to keep trying...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But if I can't sell all of these...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I'll have to pay for them myself...)

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Bands that make one person carry most of the load usually don't last very long.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, we'd be asking too much of you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm? Honami sent me a message...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She wants to talk to me before practice tomorrow... Probably about these tickets...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I appreciate her concern. I really do... But this is what's best for us right now.)
After school the next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Corridor

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(I'm so nervous...
Shiho's not one to change her mind after she's made a decision about something.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (What if we do end up fighting...?)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Admittedly, Rin and I fight a lot, but if I ever really need to tell her something, I do.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And you're trying to go pro, right? You have to work together, which also means you're not always going to agree on everything.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I'm sure you'll be fine.
You girls always find a way to get through to each other.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I have to tell her how I feel and find a solution that we can both agree on...!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sorry I'm late, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's okay. I just got here a second ago.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, okay.
So what is it that you want to talk about...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: About selling tickets...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I knew it...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (There's no way she could've left things as they are based on what happened last time...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I really don't want to force the issue but...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Sorry, but my mind's made up.
I'm going through with this and that's that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Again, you won't have time to practice our new song if you help. We can't move forward unless we get better at performing in front of a crowd.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We'd be fine if we weren't working on a new song, but that's not the case, right...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ichika and Saki are doing everything in their power to get our new song ready for our next show, so I want us to be able to do it justice.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I understand exactly how you feel, Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
We're so far behind schedule...
While Ichika and Saki are hard at work on our new song.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I understand how you selling these tickets is probably the most logical decision based on our current situation.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If that's the case, then...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I don't want to see you have to work so hard all on your own like this, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I've never sold any tickets before, but you have to ask a whole bunch of people if they'd be interested in seeing Leo/need perform, right...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That can't be easy...
Both mentally and physically.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You may have more experience than us when it comes to this, Shiho, but you're still suffering just like the rest of us.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, I have to think you're suffering more than that because you're doing this on your own.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm fine...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And I knew you'd say that, Shiho. You always do.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What if this becomes more than you can handle? What if you can't play at your best or even be in our show because of this...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, I promise to be careful...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Can't I help you with this?
Ichika and Saki might be busy, but I think I can at least lend you a hand.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Don't you still need to practice?
We don't have much time until our next show.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I know, but...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Are you on track to selling enough tickets, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm not, if I'm going to be honest...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But it's okay. I still have time until our next show. I'm sure I'll figure out something.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Figure out something...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm the one who asked for this, so I have to take full responsibility for my actions.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Even if I have a lot of trouble dealing with it, I'll get through it. So please, Honami, just focus on practicing...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Is this the right answer...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Is this how things are supposed to be? Making Shiho do all of this on her own like this...?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, bye.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho, wait...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I don't want you to keep suffering like this on your own...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You're right. What you're doing is probably what's best for our band right now...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I absolutely don't want you to carry this weight by yourself! It doesn't seem right at all!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I know that I'm asking a lot right now...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
But I want you to understand.
We care about you, Shiho. All of us.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Because you're our dear friend...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You'd be worried sick if you noticed that Saki or Ichika started pushing themselves too hard, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I would be as well.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's why I don't want to stand by and watch you do this to yourself...!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Bands that make one person carry most of the load usually don't last very long.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: I understand that you have a lot on your plate right now, but if this keeps happening, nothing good is going to come out of it.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: It'll probably also start affecting your music.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (With some extra effort on my part, the others can focus on practicing and getting our new song ready for our next show...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I'm used to doing stuff like this on my own, so it seemed like the right answer for us and for Leo/need.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Shiho, I want to help.
I'm going to help.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I want to be there for you.
I refuse to stand by and just watch you do this.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika and Saki are doing everything they can for our new song, so I want to find a way to help too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I promise to be ready to perform during our next show and also promise to help those two with our new song as much as I can.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We're all in this together...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I honestly didn't expect you to go this far, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But you can't tell Ichika or Saki about this, okay?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If they find out, I won't hear the end of it and we won't be able to sell these tickets.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, I understand. I won't tell them...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We don't have much time until our next show. It won't be easy to sell enough tickets while getting our new song ready.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Just this once, will you help me sell tickets?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes...!
